No. 2084/3 – MONDAY, AUGUST 13, 2018
EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7
My Ref. No.: BKP/LAN/ACQUI/A3/18. Land Ministry’s Reference No.: 4 - 3/15/2016/VE/298.

I, hereby give notice under Sub-Section (1) of Section 7, of Land Acquisition Act, 1964 that Government intends to acquire the land called Wagolla Division of Urumeewala Estate indicated in the following Schedule which is required for resettlement of persons displaced due to landslides in Bulathkohupitiya Divisional Secretary’s Division in 2016 . Description of the land to be acquired:- Lot No. 01 depicted in the Preliminary Plan No. K/3586 prepared by the Superintendent or Survey, Kegalle District for Surveyor General, within the boundaries shown below situated in the village of Kiriporuwa in the Grama Niladhari Division No. 107 C Kiriporuwa in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Bulathkohupitiya in the District of Kegalle in Sabaragamuwa Province. Date of examination for claims of compensation:
For the Lot No. 01 in P.P.K/3586:- On 05th October 2018 at 10.00a.m.
Schedule Lot No.01 Name of the land: Kiriporuwa Estate (Kiriporuwa Division I); Names and Addresses of the Claimants:
1. Land Reforms Commission, Colombo. 2. Managing Director, Kelany Valley Plantation
Company, 400, Deans Road, Colombo 10. 3. Ministry of Plantation Industries, 2nd Floor,

Stage II, Sethsiripaya, Baththaramulla; Extent: 1.0892 Hectare. All persons interested in the aforesaid land are hereby required to appear personally or by agents duly authorized in writing before me at Bulathkohupitiya Divisional Secretariat, on above mentioned date and time.

Further, you are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the ……………... 2018 the nature of their interests in the land, the particular of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount.
J. M. RAMYA JAYASUNDARA, Divisional Secretary/ Land Acquisition Officer, Divisional Secretariat, Bulathkohupitiya. At the Bulathkohupitiya Divisional Secretariat, 08th August, 2018. 08-950

THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
AS AMENDED BY THE LAND ACQUISITION
(AMENDEMENT) ACT NO. 28 OF 1964
Notice under Section 7

My. No.: KDS/DOL/4/4/5/3/17. Land Ministry No.: 4 - 3/13/2013/S/558. I, hereby give notice under Sub-Section (1) of Section 7, of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intended to acquire the following land for a Pubic Purpose. Description of the land to be acquired:- Five allotments of lands shown 1 and 5 in total extent about 0.1526 Hectare described as Lots 134, 135, 136, 138 and 142 in Preliminary Plan No. C.M. 320031(4)11 prepared by the Surveyor General, situated in the Kumbaloluwe Wela, in the village of Atuwe watta, Grama Niladhari Division in Kanduara Pahala Korale Minor division in Divisional Secretariat Division of Doluwa in Kandy District, Central Province. (Attached herewith the above particulars.)

The nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount.
T. A. D. W. DAYANANDA, Divisional Secretary/ Land Acquisition Officer, Doluwa. Divisional Secretariat, Doluwa, On 08th August, 2018. 08-951
